# Medipyxis Help

> Help center for Medipyxis, the wound care EMR and practice management platform for mobile wound care teams.

## Visit Wizard / EHR

- [Visit Wizard overview](https://help.medipyxis.com/modules/visit-wizard-ehr/overview/): The Visit Wizard is Medipyxis's step-by-step wound care documentation flow. It guides clinicians through 17 sections — from consent to provider attestation — so the note is complete, meets Medicare LCD documentation needs, and produces bill

- [How your progress note is written](https://help.medipyxis.com/modules/visit-wizard-ehr/progress-note/): Your progress note prints what you documented.
